sentences.en: Dewi's basketball shoes are a hand-me-down from her older sister, who also used to play.
sentences.ko: 데위의 농구화는 예전에 선수였던 언니에게서 물려받은 거예요.

sentences.text: Polisi antihuru-hara berbaris dengan perisai di depan gedung DPRD.
sentences.en: Riot police lined up with shields in front of the regional parliament building.
sentences.ko: 진압 경찰이 지방의회 건물 앞에 방패를 들고 줄지어 섰어요.

sentences.text: Logo tim Dewi berbentuk perisai dengan gambar elang.
sentences.en: Dewi's team logo is shaped like a shield with an eagle on it.
sentences.ko: 데위네 팀 로고는 독수리가 그려진 방패 모양이에요.

sentences.text: Pak Agus menerima penghargaan atas penyelamatan anak yang hanyut di sungai.
sentences.en: Mr. Agus received an award for rescuing a child swept away in the river.
sentences.ko: 아구스 경관은 강에 떠내려간 아이를 구한 공로로 상을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Blok Dewi di detik terakhir menjadi penyelamatan penting bagi tim.
sentences.en: Dewi's block in the final seconds was an important save for the team.
sentences.ko: 마지막 몇 초에 나온 데위의 블록이 팀을 살렸어요.

sentences.text: Di ruang kapolsek terpajang koleksi topi polisi dari berbagai negara.
sentences.en: In the precinct chief's office there is a collection of police caps from various countries.
sentences.ko: 지구대장실에는 여러 나라 경찰 모자가 진열돼 있어요.

sentences.text: Dewi punya koleksi kaus tim basket dari berbagai kota.
sentences.en: Dewi has a collection of basketball team jerseys from various cities.
sentences.ko: 데위는 여러 도시 농구팀 유니폼을 모아요.
